odoo.template:
<!DOCTYPE html>
-
Powered by Hudson POS Waitlist •

textarea.name: guest_note
textarea.placeholder: e.g. allergies, a quiet corner, a special occasion

details.summary: Already on the waitlist? Find My Place

form.p: Enter the phone number you joined with and we'll take you back to your place in line.

div.div: You're already on the waitlist. Here is your current status.

span.t-attf-class: wl-badge wl-state #{'wl-badge-open' if state == 'waiting' else ('wl-state-seated' if state == 'seated' else 'wl-state-done')}

div.div: Updated based on current table availability. An estimate, not a guarantee.

div.t-att-hidden: None if state == 'seated' and not status['completed'] else 'hidden'
div.span: Please come to the host stand.

p.t-att-hidden: None if state == 'seated' and not status['completed'] else 'hidden'

div.p: Your visit is complete. Thank you for dining with us! Scan the QR code again to join the waitlist for a new visit.
This waitlist entry is closed. Scan the QR code again if you'd like to rejoin.
Tip: Keep this page open or bookmark it to easily check your waitlist status.
This waitlist page is not available. Please speak with the host at the entrance.
